blocks.text: AI-powered recommendations for application segments can become defined application segments. You can add an AI-powered recommendation, which moves it to the Defined Application Segments page as a new defined application segment. You can also merge an AI-powered recommendation with an existing defined application segment. This option allows you to combine application segments that have the same grouping reasons.
To merge an AI-powered recommendation with an existing defined application segment:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Private Access > Private Applications > AI-Powered Recommendations.
Locate the AI-powered recommendation you want to merge with a defined application segment, and click the Merge icon.
In the Merge Defined Application Segment with Recommended Application Segment window:
On the Defined Application Segment tab, select the AI-powered recommendation that you want to merge with the defined application segment, and click Next.
On the AI-Powered Recommendation tab, select the necessary applications from the designated application group, and click Next.

On the Application and Ports Configuration tab, all application information (e.g., TCP and UDP port ranges) associated with the merging of your selected application segment and AI-powered recommendation are prepopulated. Check if the application information is correct and configure as needed, and click Next.

On the General Information tab, all application information associated with the merging of your selected application segment and AI-powered recommendation are prepopulated. Check if the application information is correct and configure as needed, and click Save.

blocks.text: The ability to merge an AI-powered recommendation with an existing defined application segment depends on your subscription. To learn more, contact Zscaler Support.
After you have merged the defined application segment with an AI-powered recommendation, the merged application segments are shown in the Defined Application Segments table.
